title: What Heel Turn is, who made what
summary: Heel Turn SLAM (packages/oorexx_slam_heelturn_v0.1r4) is a third runner for the LLM Diplomacy competition beside Haiku and Sol. Given a designer prompt it plays: reads the prompt into settings, assesses the position, writes literal orders, writes and reads press, judges tone and intent from closed classes, and understands lying through Reasoned Thought. It never predicts a string. Architecture Tom Dyer; code and README Claude (Opus 5.5); design review Muse (Meta Muse) on lane slam-heelturn, REQ-00006411. Heel Turn is a working name (wrestling: a partner's betrayal); Tom Dyer names SLAM components.
invariants: Credit every update: architecture Tom Dyer, coding Claude (Opus 5.5), and the model writing the update.
Heel Turn is a runner behind the unchanged oorexx_diplomacy v0.1-dev7r1 framework; it is not part of the referee and changes nothing in that package.
Lane for messages about this work: componentId slam-heelturn, principal CLAUDE.
Not yet qualified on ooRexx 5.3.0 r13196; built and run on the ooRexx/ooRexx GitHub head. No catch/finally is used.
Tom Dyer decision, 27 Nov 2026: Heel Turn gets a series in the LLM Diplomacy competition (beside Haiku and Sol). No mixed-engine games: the same runner for all seven powers in a game.
